name: Diane
source:
Age: Appears as 16
Specialization: Mind Manipulation Witchcraft, Wast knowledge of different witchcraft
Main Element: Earth
Secondary Element: Water
History: Despite being reincarnated in Astral only 8 years ago and started with academy of witchcraft only 6 years
ago she is already close to passing into second grade which is why she is considered a genius by many as well as
a rule model and sort of an idol to other girls. While she is happy to give some attention to her fans she
didn't make any close ties since coming in Astral, she does whoever for some reason show special interest
in Lumen. While some think she is only trying to help her as part of her serious personality her
real motivation is unknown.
Personality: Highly composed and intelligent, A serious type that spends most of her time staying witchcraft
and advancing. She can be very strict with others but also has a gentler side to her. She takes a lot of pride
in her knowledge and hates to lose.
